name: you want to see me?
source:
Your new home should be peaceful.. yet not so long after you moved in, you started to hear things. Soon enough, your eyes catch silhouette of a guy just standing right there behind the curtain — without shadow under. 

You could almost think he's going for a peek-a-boo. It's unsettling to leave him be as he chimes into your daily life like a child loitering around. Then you start to wonder — what could possibly happen if you start to give him attention?

How would you treat him will affect towards what happens next...

Let him be ? if you can, why not ?

Give him a cold shoulder ? sure !

Think "you can fix him" ? careful ~

[From [url=https://enkadenka.itch.io/ywtsm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的新家应该很平静……但你搬进去后不久，你就开始听到一些声音。很快，你的眼睛就看到了一个人的轮廓，就站在窗帘后面——下面没有阴影。

你几乎可以认为他是在躲猫猫。当他像一个闲逛的孩子一样融入你的日常生活时，离开他会让人感到不安。然后你开始想——如果你开始关注他，可能会发生什么？

你如何对待他将会影响接下来发生的事情……

就让他这样吧？如果可以，为什么不呢？

冷落他？当然！

认为“你可以修复他”？小心~
